title: Long column header labels wrap to two lines instead of being truncated
refs: SV-8593 (SBR spec v22 2026-08-17; shell header wrapping per Chris Ward design review 2026-08-17; exact styling to confirm live)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A report with several columns and long header labels is open (for example Sales By Representative, which has the most columns).
steps:
1. Read the column header row.
2. Find a column whose label is longer than its column is wide (for example a two-word metric heading).
3. Check whether that label is cut off or shown in full.
expected:
1. A column header label that is too long for its column width wraps onto a second line and is shown in full.
2. The label is NOT truncated with an ellipsis ("...") and is NOT cut off - the header row grows to two lines tall as needed so every heading is fully readable.
3. Confirm live against the design/build: confirm live which headings actually wrap on each report and that the two-line header row stays aligned with the data columns beneath it.
4. Note for the tester: this is the shared reporting-shell header treatment, so it applies on every report.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, the reporting-shell story SV-8593, and Chris Ward's design-review decisions of 17 August 2026 (the shell header wrapping). The Sales By Representative report specification version 22 does not name this visual treatment, so the exact styling is Loom-sourced and is marked for live confirmation above (read on 17 August 2026).
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.
